title: Transmitter 8K.... doesn‘t connent
body:
I tried to connect a G6 ID 8K____
I inserted the sensor but did‘nt start it. Then I pit the sensor in and waited for „Got Glucose“ or „Got no Raw“. None appeared.
The Transmitter randomly appeared in Bluetooth but didn‘t connect to xdrip.
After 3hours of switschin on and off Bluetooth I started the thing with the original Dexcom Receiver, that worked within minutes.
Please tell me how I could help with this.
Sincerely PeCa

comments.body:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Enabling-Debugging-for-OB1-collector

Please enable OB1 debugging and try again to connect and if it doesn't work submit logs from within xDrip and let me know when you have done.

Please also let me know which xDrip version is being used, the Phone and Android version and the dex firmware number if it shows within the xDrip status page for G5/G6 etc.

I am sorry I can‘t send you logs from within xdrip because the emailadress is missing.
Transmitter ID is 8K....
Firmware didn‘t show up
xdrip version 33e5f35-2020.02.20
Phone is SM-520F A5 2017
LineageOS 16.0 

Sincerely
Stephan aka Perito Castano
